name: wrong-version-0x01
description: Version byte 0x01 — the RETIRED v1. A v2 verifier must refuse it outright, not best-effort decode: v1's BlockExport was (number, timestamp, bytes32[] logHashes), a different ABI type whose bytes would decode to nonsense or, worse, to something plausible. This is the case that matters at the rollout cutover.
expectedError: bad version 1, want 2 (v1 is retired: refuse, do not adapt)
